intro.text: An ancient honorspren who rules the honorspren fortress of Lasting Integrity.

items.text: Sekeir greeted the Herald Kalak at Lasting Integrity, where Adolin Kholin had offered to stand trial for the Recreance. On the first day of the trial Sekeir argued with Adolin over its terms, persuading Kalak that it was to prove that humans in general couldn't be trusted, then called his witnesses, starting with Amuna.

Finding Shallan in Kalak's house, Sekeir had the Herald sequestered and took the judge's seat himself. He denounced Adolin at length and made a spectacle of the deadeye Maya, claiming to speak for her, until she found her voice, rejected him and declared the deadeyes' sacrifice their own. Sekeir was struck dumb.
After the trial, Sekeir and the other honorspren leaders were disgraced, and their isolationist policy was overturned.

appearance.text: He appears as an old man with a long blue-white beard.

personality.text: He insists that humans can't be trusted, yet is willing to manipulate others and bend the law to prove it, and takes it very personally that Adolin be shown to be no more trustworthy than anyone else.
